notes.title: Grace of Zordan is even freeer than it was
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30831037/442f858bb41cf55810cb6fda6986cbb7562530c1.png

Grace of Zordan is even freeer than it was

Hello Dear players!

For a long time, our small indie team realized that many players like the game, but making cards in it is too difficult.

Recently, any player will be able to use any cards in their decks. We really hope that you will challenge your friends to this game and enjoy the gameplay in all its glory. We believe that there are no more games like Grace of Zordan in the world.
But this game really needs community support. That is yours!

We love Grace of Zordan very much. We want you to love her too. ːsteamhappyː

Sincerely, The main developer of the game, elamaunt.

notes.title: Updated AI and the next goal
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30831037/442f858bb41cf55810cb6fda6986cbb7562530c1.png

Greetings, dear players!

We published an update to the AI, with which you will now find it more interesting to play.
If you play a custom game against AI, then you can give him additional gains. Winning a new version in this case will be a real test.

What's next?

We plan to create a set of challenges for a single player, in which the game will play against you. Or maybe you have your own ideas? Please write about them in the comments.

Have a good game!

notes.title: We have returned!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30831037/9bacc7ff00e52d9ff36a29064ef451966260f66d.png

Greetings, Dear players, the development team is with you.

We apologize for the long absence, we had financial difficulties, but we never forgot about Grace of Zordan.
We remember your impressions of the game and all the suggestions for improving it.

Over time, our team has many ideas that we want to implement in the game.

The most hot and relevant changes we implemented in this update. This includes fixing bugs that did not allow you to get full pleasure from the game in the rating match, as well as improving AI, with which you can play and experiment with the strategy. Yes, now the AI ​​does not have to wait, it goes very fast ;) In the future it will improve.

In order to interest you more, we decided to make a gift to everyone and open free cards mode until August 1 . Now you can take any cards in the game and try to win with them a ranking table. We also worked on the rating system and made it easier and more understandable. Now active players will be easier to move higher and higher on the table.

At the moment, we are more focused on developing game modes for single player. But this does not mean that the multiplayer will not change. Cards have become cheaper, and more bonuses from victories.

Have a good game and see you in the rating matches! Always with you, the development team.


List of changes (patch 1.1.2.4): 

The Free-To-Play mode is activated for all cards in the game until August 1 2018. (You can, without making in-game purchases,
use absolutely all game cards).

A new artificial intelligence BasicAI v.0.3
The design was updated.
Reduced the travel time from 120 seconds to 60 seconds.
Now the cards are automatically taken in the order of the decks, and not by accident.
Reduced prices for the legendary cards in 2 times.
Reduced prices for rare cards (from 20% to 35%).
The system of rating awards and penalties has been improved. (Now at least + 10pts for the win
and a maximum of -20pts per defeat for any rating difference).

Fixed zero timer bug in rating game mode.
Fixed a bug in the players' out of sync and loss of game state when the connection to the Internet was poor.
Corrected the situation of incorrect attribution of victory or defeat.

P. S. don't forget to join in our discord: https://discord.gg/AZKjV7f

notes.title: Update 1.0.2.2
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30831037/9a44a88cb05798735444e4aab52a994ea692beab.png

Update 1.0.2.2

Swordsman armor has been reduced from 2 to 1.
Attack "Troll" increased from 1 to 2.
Attack "Tribe Warrior" reduced from 2 to 1.
The "Barricade" health points of the "Engineer" creature are reduced from 6 to 4.
Health points "Carnivorous Plant" reduced from 4 to 3.
The cost of the "Grow a Plant" ability has been reduced from 3 to 2.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30831037/fc2b190a88d4b1e044d0b89f664d28aef6a9084a.png

Added bonus for defeat if the duration of the game exceeds some time.

The zoom in learning is disabled.

Fixed crashes when the sound engine was loaded incorrectly.
Fixed crashes with incorrect messages in the chat.
Fixed crashes when leaving the game scene.
Fixed some bugs that prevent the correct start of the game.
Fixed crashes when an incorrect request for a duel.

Fixed the description of "Sirin" in the English version of the game.
The message "Miss" is replaced by "Immunity", so as not to confuse players anymore.
Fixed a loss of the deck when leaving the match, if the match was started during the assembly of the deck.

Many small changes.

notes.content:

Update without changing version.

Automatic error reporting has been implemented. If the game crashed, when you restart it, you will be asked to send information to the developers.

Fixed updating of the list of players and its layout problems.

Fixed crash if the player incorrectly downloaded the avatar.

Fixed crash when downloading the game, when the incorrect loading of sounds.

Fixed a message about an unsuccessful order. Before that, it was not shown or was shown to the wrong player.

Fixed crash when using buttons in watching the game through an observer.

Fixed a crash when requesting a duel, when the player was unable to process the request.

Fixed crash when sending an empty message to the chat.

Fixed crash if the player's nickname in the chat does not contain any characters.

Optimized the launch of the game under the 64-bit version of the operating system.

notes.title: How to get cards in Grace of Zordan?
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30831037/442f858bb41cf55810cb6fda6986cbb7562530c1.png

How can I get all the cards without donate?

This information will tell you how gold is credited in the game Grace of Zordan.

Once a day for a victory, the player receives 50 gold.
If he has 0 PTS, for the subsequent 4 wins, the player will receive another 10 of gold and then for each subsequent victory by 1 of gold.

It turns out, for 5 victories you can get 90 gold per day.
For every 50 PTS you increase the number of awards for 10 gold by 1, i.e. if you have a 450 rating, you will get 180 gold for 14 victories.

Total: not much gold for 1 day. But in the game there is a system of boosters that multiply your rewards for winning the rating matches in 2, 5, 10. 
With the booster X10 for 5 wins in the ranking match you will get 900 gold with 0 PTS and 1800 gold at 450 PTS for 14 victories. Boosters are very profitable, even bought for gold, if you win 5 games a day.

Also you get gold for each level increase. For every next level you will receive more and more gold. For the 2 level you get 205 gold, for 9 level you get 300 gold, etc. But this gold is not multiplied by a booster for gold.
Also, there are experience boosters in the game that multiply the experience gained in 2, 5, 10 times.
If you buy a booster on the experience for diamonds, it will be profitable even with a little activity, and if for gold, you need to play a lot to pay it back.


How can I get all the cards with the minimum donat?

You need to buy diamonds, buy booster on them gold and experience. Next, sit quietly playing, winning at least 5 games a day. You very quickly buy up all the rare cards and can already save on the legendary. As you can see, it is not necessary to spend all your free time in the game. It is enough to be a stably active player. In addition, there will be little expensive cards, we will add not only legendary cards to the game, but also ordinary ones, and rare ones, which will have a small price.

In today's update, the price of boosters on X2 and X5 will be reduced, as we realized that the price is quite high for new players who are trying to accumulate on their first booster.

P.S. We, as players, test this system on ourselves and try to make it the most correct one. So far, the system works like this, but we constantly think about it. Early access is intended for this purpose.
Perhaps there will be some changes.
